description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing news items in an admin interface, including creating, updating, deleting, and listing news entries. It uses middleware for authentication and file upload handling, and interacts with a NewsItem data model and external storage functions.

methods.name: POST /news
methods.description: Create a new custom news item with optional image upload.

methods.name: PUT /news/:id
methods.description: Update an existing news item by id, with optional image replacement.

methods.name: DELETE /news/:id
methods.description: Delete a news item by id.

methods.name: GET /news
methods.description: Retrieve a list of news items, optionally filtered by category.

ctags.name: upload
ctags.pattern: /^const upload = multer({ storage: multer.memoryStorage(), limits: { fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 } }/
